claims.description:
One row per adjudicated claim header. This is the fact table for all spend, denial and utilisation questions.
Financial rules that always hold:
  - plan_paid is what the plan paid; member_responsibility is what the member owes.
  - For PAID claims from an in-network provider: plan_paid + member_responsibility = allowed_amount.
  - For PAID claims from an out-of-network provider the member is also balance-billed the difference between billed_amount and allowed_amount, so plan_paid + member_responsibility = billed_amount instead.
  - DENIED and PENDING claims have allowed_amount = 0 and plan_paid = 0. Always filter on status before summing money.

columns.plan_id: VARCHAR foreign key to plans.plan_id; the plan in force for the member.
columns.place_of_service: VARCHAR CMS place-of-service code: '11' office, '22' outpatient hospital, '23' emergency room, '24' ambulatory surgical centre, '81' independent laboratory. Compare as text, never as a number.
columns.service_date: DATE the care was delivered. Use this for utilisation and trend questions.
columns.received_date: DATE the claim arrived at the plan. Use this for timely-filing questions.
columns.paid_date: DATE the claim finished adjudication; NULL while status = 'pending'. Use this for cash-flow and turnaround questions.
columns.status: VARCHAR, one of 'paid', 'denied', 'pending'. Always filter on this before summing money.
columns.allowed_amount: DOUBLE, the contracted amount the plan recognises. 0 for denied and pending claims.
columns.plan_paid: DOUBLE, the plan's share. Sum this to answer 'how much did we pay'.
columns.member_responsibility: DOUBLE, the member's share (copay, coinsurance, or -- out of network -- also the balance above the allowed amount).
columns.denial_code: VARCHAR foreign key to denial_codes.denial_code. NULL unless status = 'denied', so use 'denial_code IS NOT NULL' rather than comparing to an empty string.

claim_lines.description: One row per service line within a claim. Join to claims on claim_id. Use this table -- not claims -- for anything about specific procedures or diagnoses. Line amounts sum to the claim header amounts.

columns.line_number: BIGINT sequence within the claim, starting at 1.
columns.procedure_code: VARCHAR CPT or HCPCS code, e.g. '99213', 'J1885'. Never cast to a number.
columns.units: BIGINT count of units billed on the line.
columns.allowed_amount: DOUBLE allowed for this line; 0 unless the parent claim is paid.

members.description: One row per enrolled member. Fully synthetic and de-identified: there are no names, addresses or dates of birth, only a birth year. A member with an empty enrollment_end is still enrolled.

columns.birth_year: BIGINT year of birth. Approximate age = 2025 - birth_year.
columns.state: VARCHAR two-letter state code: WA, OR or ID.
columns.enrollment_end: DATE coverage ended, NULL if still enrolled. Test with IS NULL.
columns.risk_score: DOUBLE morbidity index; 1.0 is average. Higher means sicker.

providers.description: One row per contracted or non-contracted provider organisation. All names are fictional.

columns.network_status: VARCHAR, 'in_network' or 'out_of_network'. Out-of-network claims deny more often and cost members more.

plans.description: One row per benefit plan design. The numeric benefit values here are the authoritative cost-sharing amounts; the policy documents describe the rules in prose. When a question asks for a dollar figure, prefer this table over the documents.

columns.deductible_individual: BIGINT annual individual deductible, in dollars.
columns.deductible_family: BIGINT annual family deductible, in dollars.
columns.oop_max_individual: BIGINT annual individual out-of-pocket maximum, in dollars.
columns.coinsurance_rate: DOUBLE member coinsurance after deductible, as a fraction (0.20 = 20%).
columns.pcp_copay: BIGINT primary-care visit copay, in dollars. 0 on the HSA plan, which uses coinsurance instead.
columns.specialist_copay: BIGINT specialist visit copay, in dollars.
columns.er_copay: BIGINT emergency room copay, in dollars.
columns.urgent_care_copay: BIGINT urgent care copay, in dollars.
columns.rx_generic_copay: BIGINT generic prescription copay, in dollars.
columns.rx_brand_copay: BIGINT brand prescription copay, in dollars.

denial_codes.description: Lookup table describing each denial reason, its category, and whether it can be appealed. Join from claims.denial_code to translate a code into something a human can act on.

columns.short_description: VARCHAR one-line explanation of the denial.
columns.is_appealable: BIGINT, 1 if the denial can be appealed, else 0.
columns.appeal_window_days: BIGINT days the member has to file an appeal; 0 when not appealable.
columns.typical_resolution: VARCHAR standard operational next step for this denial.
